From Sanskrit वेद (veda). Schwa sounds are deleted at the end of Hindi words but not in Sanskrit. वेद is pronounced as veda in Sanskrit, but pronounced as ved in Hindi. The inclusion of the "a" at the end of the Sanskrit pronunciation and in languages that do not engage in schwa deletion has led to misspellings of वेद with a long a matra by some Hindi speakers.
